title: Modernize Legacy Codebase to C#
problem_statement: The current VB6 codebase is outdated and lacks modern programming practices.
risk_if_unaddressed: Continued use of outdated code may lead to increased maintenance costs and security vulnerabilities.
suggested_approach: Refactor the codebase to C# using modern conventions and practices.
success_criteria: Codebase is fully converted to C#.
